objective: Create Crossing lines, a new math-rock sketch with a sustained global bass. Build a 3:2 polyrhythm in separate guitar and drum voices across four quarter notes. Make an independent variation of the three-pulse riff, scale it to two thirds with fixed note durations, then place its repetitions in a new voice. Compare source and variation, inspect expected/actual grids and cycle alignments, and mark where the two cycles next start together. Verify the original riff and bass are unchanged, export the song, and explicitly finish.
